card.statement:
It was shown in <<cite:MR97k:17014>>, Theorem 5.4 that imaginary Verma
module $M(\lambda)$ over affine $\hat{\mathfrak sl}(2)$ admits a
quantum deformation to the imaginary Verma module $M_q(\lambda)$
over $U_q$ in such a way that the dimensions of the weight spaces
are invariant under the deformation, generalizing the Lusztig's
deformation functor constructed originally for classical Verma
modules <<cite:MR954661>>, see also <<cite:MR1662112>>.
Theorem <<ref:thm-imag-irred>> shows that Lusztig's deformation
functor preserves module structure in the case of imaginary Verma
modules (see <<cite:MR95a:17030>>).
card.label: Remark 16

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules and Kashiwara algebras for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
